item.title: Gov. Katie Hobbs launches Know Your Rights website
item.description: Gov. Katie Hobbs launched the Know Your Rights website on Wednesday to inform Arizonans of their rights when engaging with federal law enforcement.

item.title: Pentagon says it’s cutting ties with ‘woke’ Harvard, discontinuing military training, fellowships
item.description: The Pentagon said Friday it is cutting ties with Harvard University, ending all military training, fellowships and certificate programs with the Ivy League institution. The announcement marks the latest development in the Trump administration’s prolonged standoff with Harvard over the White House’s demands for reforms at the Ivy League school. item.title: Gov. Katie Hobbs signs bipartisan bill to change Arizona primary election dates
item.description: Gov. Katie Hobbs signed a bipartisan bill to permanently change the date of primary elections in the Grand Canyon State after it was passed by the Arizona Legislature.

item.title: Cash buyer snags Paradise Valley lot for highest price paid in Arizona this year
item.description: A 4.75-acre lot in a highly sought-after area of Paradise Valley sold for $14.3 million in cash.

item.title: Arizona man to be extradited from Mississippi in connection with Tolleson homicide
item.description: A 27-year-old Arizona man will be extradited from Mississippi after being arrested Friday in connection with a homicide in Tolleson, authorities said.
